name: zdeclient_crater_create_feature_struct_from_event_template
description: zDEClient_Crater::CreateFeatureStructFromEventTemplate allocates a crater feature, copies the event template, allocates points and clip output, and selects the matching display-source entry.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zDEClient crater/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x457040 validates allocating and zeroing the 0x50-byte feature, featureType 1, copying the 0x28-byte event template, allocating zVec3[pointCount], creating the clip-patch output, defaulting displaySourceEntry to g_zDEClient_CraterDisplaySourceList when textured flags are present, and scanning later display-source entries for a matching source material.
The native zDEClient feature leaf smoke verifies feature type, template copy, point allocation, clip output allocation, and selection of the matching display-source entry.
